symptoms_en: Password-expiry message; user cannot sign in or is prompted to change the password.
symptoms_ar: كلمة المرور انتهت صلاحيتها
possible_causes: Identity provider password expiry policy reached its limit.
Password-change workflow may be unavailable or incomplete.
discriminating_questions: Does the sign-in screen explicitly say the password expired, or does it say the account is locked?
Can you access another corporate application with the same account?
required_evidence: Identity provider reports password_expired=TRUE.
User can complete the approved password-change flow.
safe_checks: Read account status using the simulated identity check; never request or retain the user's password.
exclusion_criteria: Account status reports locked or disabled without expiry; password_expired=FALSE; only one application fails while other applications work.

resolution_steps.instruction: Open the approved self-service password-reset/change portal and follow the identity verification prompts.
Set a new password without sharing it in chat; update saved credentials on devices after successful sign-in.
Ask the user to confirm sign-in succeeds before recording resolution.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Any security alert, privileged account, critical priority, or inability to verify identity requires human handling.

symptoms_en: Account reports locked after repeated failed sign-ins; saved credentials on another device may keep retrying.
symptoms_ar: الحساب اتقفل بعد محاولات دخول فاشلة
possible_causes: Repeated incorrect credentials triggered a lock.
A device may continue submitting stale saved credentials.
discriminating_questions: Did the lock follow repeated incorrect passwords, or a security/suspicious-activity notice?
Are any phones or mail clients still retrying an old saved password?
required_evidence: Identity check reports locked=TRUE and no security-policy trigger.
Stale saved credentials or repeated incorrect password attempts may be present.
safe_checks: Read simulated account lock and enabled state; check for a security-policy indicator. Do not attempt repeated sign-ins.
exclusion_criteria: Security-policy/suspicious-activity lock indicator; locked=FALSE; disabled account is the actual state.

resolution_steps.instruction: IAM verifies identity and reviews the lock reason before unlocking the account.
After IAM approval, help the user update stale saved credentials on devices.
Confirm sign-in works and record the user confirmation.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Any suspicious-activity or security-policy lock must be escalated to Security Operations.
Identity cannot be verified; privileged account; critical priority.

symptoms_en: Approval notification does not arrive, authenticator code is rejected, or MFA stopped after a phone change.
symptoms_ar: مشكلة في التحقق متعدد العوامل أو إشعار الموافقة
possible_causes: Authenticator is not enrolled on the current device.
Push delivery or time-based code validation is failing.
MFA may be locked after repeated attempts.
discriminating_questions: Does the password succeed before MFA is requested?
Did you recently replace/reset your phone, or does the authenticator code appear but get rejected?
required_evidence: Identity provider reports MFA not enrolled, registration mismatch, or MFA lock.
Push delivery may be blocked or a replaced device may not be registered.
safe_checks: Check MFA enrollment/lock state; compare with identity-provider health; do not bypass MFA.
exclusion_criteria: Password is rejected before MFA; account disabled/locked; broad identity-provider outage.

resolution_steps.instruction: IAM verifies identity and resets MFA registration when approved.
User enrolls the authenticator on the current device using the approved flow.
Confirm successful sign-in without bypassing MFA.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Suspected MFA fatigue, unauthorized prompts, suspicious sign-in, or account compromise must be escalated to Security Operations.
Privileged access or critical priority.

symptoms_en: User can sign in to other corporate systems but a specific portal/app says access denied or role missing.
symptoms_ar: لا توجد صلاحية أو دور مطلوب على التطبيق
possible_causes: Required application role/group is absent.
Provisioning or approval for the role is pending.
discriminating_questions: Can you sign in to other corporate applications using the same account?
Does the error say access denied/role missing, rather than password or MFA failure?
required_evidence: Application entitlement check returns entitled=FALSE or provisioning_state=ABSENT.
A role may require manager/application-owner approval.
safe_checks: Check application entitlement and provisioning state; verify approval status through approved workflow.
exclusion_criteria: Entitled=TRUE and provisioning ACTIVE; application health is UNAVAILABLE; general sign-in fails across apps.

resolution_steps.instruction: Confirm the application and requested role with the user.
Application owner reviews entitlement request and required manager approval.
Apply the approved role and verify access.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Any privileged role or security-sensitive access requires human review and approval.
Never grant access solely on a chat request.

symptoms_en: One application rejects sign-in while other corporate applications work; application-specific SSO/session error.
symptoms_ar: التطبيق بيرفض تسجيل الدخول رغم عمل الأنظمة الأخرى
possible_causes: Application-specific SSO mapping/session is inconsistent.
Application authentication configuration is failing.
discriminating_questions: Do other corporate applications accept the same account?
Does the app show a service-unavailable message or an authentication/SSO error?
required_evidence: Application SSO mapping/session issue; app-specific authentication configuration; stale application session.
safe_checks: Check application service health and application-specific authentication status; compare with identity-provider status.
exclusion_criteria: Password expired, account locked/disabled, MFA failure before application launch, or application health unavailable indicating outage.

resolution_steps.instruction: Try the approved sign-out/sign-in flow once, if safe and allowed.
Application Support reviews SSO mapping/session logs and corrects application-side configuration.
Confirm application sign-in succeeds.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Security alerts, privileged access, or critical priority require human handling.

symptoms_en: An application opens but an action fails, shows an error code, or stops during processing.
symptoms_ar: التطبيق بيفتح لكن العملية بتفشل
possible_causes: Application defect or invalid input.
A dependency or backend operation is failing.
discriminating_questions: Does the application open and fail only after a specific action, or is it unavailable before login?
Do colleagues using the same function see the same error?
required_evidence: Application defect; invalid or inconsistent input; dependency failure; service degradation.
safe_checks: Capture exact error text/time and affected function; check service health and recent similar tickets.
exclusion_criteria: Application cannot be reached by multiple users; device alone is affected; the issue is only access/authorization.

resolution_steps.instruction: Capture the error text, timestamp, and steps to reproduce without collecting sensitive data.
Application Support reviews logs and reproduces the failure in a safe test context.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Data loss, security impact, critical priority, or production-impacting irreversible operations require human handling.

symptoms_en: Service unavailable/timeouts affect several users or a shared application; multiple reports occur close together.
symptoms_ar: التطبيق متوقف أو غير متاح لعدة مستخدمين
possible_causes: Application service or shared dependency is unavailable.
A recent change or capacity issue may have affected the service.
discriminating_questions: Are multiple users affected on the same application and location/time window?
Is the error service-unavailable/timeout, rather than access denied for one user?
required_evidence: Application service failure or shared dependency outage; potentially infrastructure-caused.
safe_checks: Check service health; count recent tickets by category, CI and location; check for an open global ticket first.
exclusion_criteria: Health is OPERATIONAL and only one user's entitlement/authentication fails; reports are spread over days/sites and below outage threshold.

resolution_steps.instruction: Application Support validates service health and impact scope.
If threshold is met, create/link a global incident and notify the owner group.
Restore service under incident procedures and verify monitoring/user recovery.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human-led for critical priority or suspected security impact.

symptoms_en: Changes or records appear late between systems; one direction or a subset of records may lag.
symptoms_ar: تأخر مزامنة البيانات أو عدم تحديثها
possible_causes: Synchronization queue/backlog is delayed.
Source/target connection or rejected records prevent updates.
discriminating_questions: Are all records delayed or only specific records?
Is the source system updated while the destination remains stale?
required_evidence: Queue backlog; scheduled sync delayed; source/target connection issue; rejected records.
safe_checks: Check sync status/last-success timestamp and service health; compare recent tickets.
exclusion_criteria: Both source and target are unavailable; record was never saved at source; user lacks access rather than data freshness.

resolution_steps.instruction: Record example record IDs using synthetic/non-sensitive identifiers and the last known update time.
Application Support inspects sync queue, rejected records, and dependency status.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Potential data corruption, data exposure, or critical business processing impact requires human review.

symptoms_en: Sign-in says account disabled/deactivated rather than password expired or locked.
symptoms_ar: الحساب متوقف أو معطّل
possible_causes: Account lifecycle/admin action disabled the account.
Reactivation may require authorized approval.
discriminating_questions: Does the message explicitly say disabled/deactivated, or locked/incorrect password?
Is the account expected to be active under the organization's access process?
required_evidence: Account disabled by lifecycle/admin action; identity status no longer enabled.
safe_checks: Check enabled/locked/password-expired status in the simulated identity system.
exclusion_criteria: enabled=TRUE and only app-specific access denied; locked=TRUE; password_expired=TRUE.

resolution_steps.instruction: IAM verifies account lifecycle and the authorized reactivation request.
Reactivate only after required approval and audit checks.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Security-related disablement, termination/lifecycle ambiguity, privileged access, or critical priority must be human-led.

symptoms_en: One printer is offline or print jobs remain queued; other device/network functions may work.
symptoms_ar: الطابعة غير متصلة أو الطباعة متوقفة
possible_causes: Printer power/connectivity or queue issue.
Shared print service or network path may be unavailable.
discriminating_questions: Is one user affected or everyone using the same printer?
Can the printer be reached/seen by other users on the same network?
required_evidence: Printer powered off/disconnected; local queue/spooler issue; shared printer/network issue.
safe_checks: Check printer status/queue and whether the issue is local or shared; avoid clearing others' jobs without approval.
exclusion_criteria: Multiple sites/printers fail simultaneously; network reachability broadly fails; printer reports healthy and only one document fails.

resolution_steps.instruction: Check printer power, paper/jam indicators, and selected printer.
Clear only the affected user's stuck job if policy permits; escalate shared printer faults.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Shared business-critical printing outage or critical priority requires human handling.

symptoms_en: Low disk-space warning; updates or local saves fail; issue isolated to one device.
symptoms_ar: مساحة الجهاز ممتلئة أو قليلة
possible_causes: Temporary files/downloads consumed endpoint capacity.
Local storage capacity or quota is exhausted.
discriminating_questions: Is the warning on one device or are multiple users seeing a shared storage error?
Does the storage check show low free space on the endpoint, or is a network drive affected?
required_evidence: Temporary files/downloads consume space; disk quota/storage capacity exhausted.
safe_checks: Read available disk-space metrics; identify only approved temporary/cache files for possible cleanup.
exclusion_criteria: Endpoint has adequate free space; shared server/storage service is failing; multiple users affected on shared storage.

resolution_steps.instruction: Review storage usage and remove only user-approved, non-business temporary files or downloads.
Run approved disk cleanup and confirm free space and update success.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Do not delete business data; if data loss risk, encryption/ransomware signs, or critical priority, stop and escalate.

symptoms_en: User requests administrator/elevated access, even temporarily.
symptoms_ar: طلب صلاحيات إدارية أو مرتفعة
possible_causes: A legitimate task requires time-bound elevated permissions.
Requested scope may exceed least-privilege requirements.
discriminating_questions: What exact task and duration require elevated access?
Is the requested role privileged/admin rather than ordinary application access?
required_evidence: Legitimate time-bound administrative need; request may require manager and security approval.
safe_checks: Check request/approval status and least-privilege options; do not grant access.
exclusion_criteria: The request is only a standard app role with no elevated permissions; route according to the application entitlement workflow.

resolution_steps.instruction: Record business justification, scope, and requested expiry.
Obtain manager and security approval and grant only through the approved access workflow.
Verify expiry/removal is scheduled and auditable.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Mandatory human approval by IAM/security; always human-led regardless of confidence.

symptoms_en: Account blocked after suspicious sign-in or security-policy notice.
symptoms_ar: الحساب اتقفل بسبب تنبيه أو سياسة أمنية
possible_causes: Identity risk controls detected suspicious sign-in activity.
Security policy blocked the account pending review.
discriminating_questions: Did the user receive a suspicious-activity/security alert, or was the lock only after incorrect passwords?
Does the identity status indicate a security-policy lock reason?
required_evidence: Identity risk engine or security policy blocked the account due to suspicious activity.
safe_checks: Check the security lock reason and preserve audit references; do not unlock or ask user to bypass controls.
exclusion_criteria: Identity evidence confirms ordinary lock after failed attempts with no risk/security indicator.

resolution_steps.instruction: Preserve alert details and route immediately to Security Operations.
Security Operations validates sign-in activity and decides containment/unlock.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human-led; all suspected compromise or suspicious activity goes to Security Operations.

symptoms_en: One user cannot connect to VPN; others at same site can connect; client shows configuration/credential error.
symptoms_ar: مشكلة اتصال VPN عند مستخدم واحد
possible_causes: Local VPN client/profile configuration is incorrect.
Local connectivity or cached client credentials are stale.
discriminating_questions: Can colleagues at the same site connect to VPN right now?
Can the user reach the internet and does the VPN client show a local configuration/credential error?
required_evidence: Client version/configuration issue; stale local credentials; local connectivity issue.
safe_checks: Check service health and recent VPN ticket count before local troubleshooting.
exclusion_criteria: Multiple users at one site fail within a short window; VPN service health is unavailable; broad internet/network failure.

resolution_steps.instruction: Check approved VPN client configuration and collect the exact error message.
Network Operations reviews client profile or credential/configuration faults.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Suspected credential compromise, security alert, or critical priority requires human handling.

symptoms_en: Problem appears limited to one laptop/device; other users and shared services are unaffected.
symptoms_ar: مشكلة محلية في الجهاز
possible_causes: Local OS, device configuration, driver, or client process issue.
A device-specific peripheral or software fault.
discriminating_questions: Does the same task work on another device or for a colleague?
Is the affected service healthy and is the issue limited to this endpoint?
required_evidence: Local OS/app process issue; device configuration; peripheral or client problem.
safe_checks: Check device health and approved diagnostic logs; compare with service status.
exclusion_criteria: Multiple users/devices share the same failure; service health is degraded; endpoint storage is full.

resolution_steps.instruction: Capture device model/asset reference and reproduce with a non-sensitive test.
Endpoint Support reviews device logs/configuration and applies approved repair.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Malware/ransomware signs, suspected data exposure, or critical priority require human handling.

symptoms_en: Several users at the same site cannot connect to VPN in a short period.
symptoms_ar: خدمة VPN متوقفة لعدة مستخدمين
possible_causes: Shared VPN gateway/service is unavailable.
A common network or identity dependency is failing.
discriminating_questions: Are multiple users at the same site affected within the same short time window?
Can affected users reach other network services, and is VPN health UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED?
required_evidence: VPN gateway/service outage; shared authentication or network dependency.
safe_checks: Check for open global ticket first; count recent tickets in the same CI/category/location/time window; inspect VPN health.
exclusion_criteria: Only one user/device affected and peers connect; tickets are spread across days or sites and do not meet threshold.

resolution_steps.instruction: Network Operations validates gateway health and scope.
When threshold is met, create or link a global incident and notify Network Operations.
Restore service under incident procedure and confirm recovery.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Critical priority or security indicators require human incident command.

symptoms_en: Suspicious email/message asks for credentials, payment, or urgent link click.
symptoms_ar: رسالة أو رابط تصيّد مشبوه
possible_causes: Credential-harvesting link or spoofed sender.
Malicious attachment or social-engineering message.
discriminating_questions: Did you click the link, open the attachment, or enter credentials?
Does the message request credentials/payment or create unusual urgency?
required_evidence: Credential harvesting; spoofed sender; malicious link or attachment.
safe_checks: Record sender/subject/time and user actions; use approved reporting channel; do not open links/attachments.
exclusion_criteria: Verified benign message through trusted security process; user only reports unrelated mail delivery failure.

resolution_steps.instruction: Do not click, reply, forward broadly, or open attachments; report via approved security channel.
Security Operations analyzes the message and determines containment.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human-led; if credentials entered or attachment opened, notify Security Operations immediately.

symptoms_en: Device cannot join Wi-Fi or disconnects while nearby users may or may not be affected.
symptoms_ar: مشكلة اتصال بشبكة الواي فاي
possible_causes: Device adapter/profile issue.
Access point, wireless authentication, or shared wireless service issue.
discriminating_questions: Can another device connect to the same Wi-Fi at the same location?
Can this device connect to a different approved network?
required_evidence: Device-specific adapter/profile issue; access point/authentication problem; wider wireless outage.
safe_checks: Check wireless service health and scope; collect device-side connection error without exposing network secrets.
exclusion_criteria: All network connectivity fails beyond Wi-Fi; multiple sites affected; device connects normally to same SSID.

resolution_steps.instruction: Confirm Wi-Fi is enabled and select the approved corporate network.
Forget/rejoin the approved network only if policy permits; do not disclose shared secrets.
Network Operations investigates access-point or authentication failures.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Security alerts or critical priority require human handling.

symptoms_en: Internal hostnames fail to resolve while direct IP access may work; browser says server not found for internal names.
symptoms_ar: أسماء المواقع الداخلية لا تعمل مع أن الاتصال بالـ IP يعمل
possible_causes: Internal DNS resolver/record problem.
Stale DNS cache or connectivity to the resolver.
discriminating_questions: Do internal hostnames fail while direct IP access works?
Do external websites resolve normally, or does all network connectivity fail?
required_evidence: DNS resolver/record issue; stale cache; internal DNS connectivity issue.
safe_checks: Run approved DNS lookup/health check; compare resolver status and recent tickets.
exclusion_criteria: Direct IP also fails and broad connectivity is down; host is unreachable for unrelated reasons.

resolution_steps.instruction: Capture affected hostname category and exact time; do not include real sensitive hostnames in demo artifacts.
Network Operations checks DNS records/resolver and clears cache only under approved procedure.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Broad critical network impact requires human incident handling.

symptoms_en: Shared service/server is unreachable or failing for multiple users; may correlate with infrastructure health alerts.
symptoms_ar: السيرفر أو خدمة مشتركة غير متاحة
possible_causes: Shared compute host or service dependency failed.
Infrastructure resource exhaustion or service degradation.
discriminating_questions: Are multiple users/services affected, or one application function only?
Does infrastructure health show an unavailable host/dependency?
required_evidence: Compute/service failure; resource exhaustion; host or dependency outage.
safe_checks: Check infrastructure/service health and recent incidents; collect timestamps and affected CI.
exclusion_criteria: Only one user's entitlement/authentication fails; only one endpoint is affected; application health alone identifies a local app fault.

resolution_steps.instruction: Servers & Infrastructure validates host/dependency status and impact.
Restore under approved incident/runbook and record evidence.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Critical priority or suspected security impact always requires human handling.

symptoms_en: Endpoint behaves suspiciously, security alert appears, or malware/ransomware is suspected.
symptoms_ar: اشتباه في برمجية خبيثة أو إصابة الجهاز
possible_causes: Malicious software or possible endpoint compromise.
Security alert may also require analyst validation for false positive.
discriminating_questions: Did an approved security tool show an alert, or is the report based only on unusual behavior?
Are files being encrypted, security tools disabled, or unexpected prompts appearing?
required_evidence: Malicious software; false-positive alert; compromised endpoint.
safe_checks: Capture alert identifier and time; isolate only according to approved incident response policy; do not run unapproved cleanup.
exclusion_criteria: Security tooling confirms a benign false positive; symptoms map to a verified non-security device fault.

resolution_steps.instruction: Stop routine troubleshooting and contact Security Operations immediately.
Security Operations decides containment, evidence preservation, and recovery.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human-led. Suspected active compromise/ransomware is immediate escalation.

symptoms_en: User asks how to configure/use an approved service without reporting a fault.
symptoms_ar: طلب إرشادات أو خطوات استخدام
possible_causes: User needs instructions for a supported setup/task.
Request may reveal an underlying fault when clarified.
discriminating_questions: Are you asking for instructions, or is an existing service failing with an error?
Which approved device/app and step are you trying to complete?
required_evidence: Normal how-to request; setup guidance; uncertainty about supported process.
safe_checks: Retrieve approved knowledge article and verify supported platform/version.
exclusion_criteria: A service is actually failing, access is denied, or security-sensitive/privileged action is requested.

resolution_steps.instruction: Provide the approved step-by-step knowledge article for the user's supported platform.
Ask whether the guidance completed the task; open an incident if an actual fault remains.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Privileged access, security-sensitive requests, or critical priority require human handling.

symptoms_en: Vague report such as 'system not working' without enough context to distinguish causes.
symptoms_ar: وصف عام للمشكلة بدون معلومات كافية
possible_causes: Root cause is unknown; identity, application, endpoint, network, or outage are still candidates.
discriminating_questions: What exact service and error do you see?
Are other users affected, and can you access other corporate apps/network services?
required_evidence: Could be identity, application, endpoint, network, or a wider outage; no root cause is established.
safe_checks: Check ticket completeness; check for an open global ticket; use broad service-health checks and similar-ticket search.
exclusion_criteria: Do not exclude alternatives until evidence is available; do not treat similar wording as proof.

resolution_steps.instruction: Collect the affected service, exact error, onset time, user scope, and whether other services work.
Route to human triage if evidence remains insufficient after targeted questions/checks.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human triage when diagnosis remains inconclusive; mandatory for security, privileged access, or critical priority.

symptoms_en: Browser/client reports certificate expired or certificate validation failure for a service.
symptoms_ar: شهادة أمان منتهية الصلاحية
possible_causes: Service certificate validity period expired.
Certificate chain/configuration may be invalid; device clock is a competing explanation.
discriminating_questions: Does the warning show an expired certificate, or an untrusted/hostname mismatch?
Are multiple users seeing the same service certificate warning?
required_evidence: Expired server certificate; incomplete chain; incorrect device clock may produce validation symptoms.
safe_checks: Check certificate validity and service health through approved read-only checks.
exclusion_criteria: Certificate is valid and only one device clock/profile is incorrect; broad network/DNS failure explains reachability.

resolution_steps.instruction: Application Support/Infrastructure validates certificate chain and expiry.
Renew/replace certificate through approved change control and verify clients.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Certificate warnings affecting authentication or suspected interception must be escalated to a human/security team.

symptoms_en: User suspects sensitive data was sent to the wrong recipient, shared publicly, or exposed unexpectedly.
symptoms_ar: اشتباه في كشف أو مشاركة بيانات حساسة
possible_causes: Sensitive information may have been shared with an unintended recipient.
A link or permission may have exposed information beyond intended audience.
discriminating_questions: What type of data may be exposed, and when was it shared?
Was the recipient/link authorized, and has the exposure been contained through approved process?
required_evidence: Misaddressed message; excessive permissions; public link; unauthorized access.
safe_checks: Capture minimum necessary details; do not copy sensitive content into chat; preserve references and escalate.
exclusion_criteria: Verified no sensitive data was involved and the sharing path was authorized by the data owner.

resolution_steps.instruction: Stop further sharing and report immediately to Security Operations using approved incident channel.
Security Operations/privacy owner assesses scope, containment, and notification obligations.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Always human-led; suspected data exposure must be escalated immediately.

symptoms_en: Shared storage location/service unavailable or read/write operations fail for multiple users.
symptoms_ar: مشكلة في خدمة التخزين المشتركة
possible_causes: Shared storage backend or service is unavailable.
Capacity/quota or storage dependency failure.
discriminating_questions: Is the problem a local device disk warning or a shared drive/service used by multiple users?
Can users read existing files but not write, or is the share entirely unavailable?
required_evidence: Shared storage service failure; capacity/quota issue; storage backend or dependency failure.
safe_checks: Check storage-service health and scope; count recent incidents on the same CI/location.
exclusion_criteria: Only one endpoint has low free disk space; service health is operational and only one user's permissions fail.

resolution_steps.instruction: Servers & Infrastructure checks storage capacity, service health, and logs.
Restore under approved runbook and verify read/write using safe test data.

mandatory_human_escalation_conditions: Data integrity risk, suspected exposure, or critical priority requires human handling.
